Technical mentoring: Coach and mentor engineers in structured systems thinking, validation strategy, and data-driven decision making — supporting capability development aligned to the Systems Engineering Maturity Roadmap Customer Centric: Participates actively in customer-facing technical discussions, contributing system-level insights that demonstrate product value and support requirements clarification.
